summary: Pittsburgh resident, parent of young children, software engineer with a focus on programming languages (especially Lisp and Clojure), strong interest in artificial intelligence and natural language processing, critical of corporate practices and income inequality, engaged in discussions about education and social issues, values ethical considerations in technology, has a background in computer science and philosophy, participates in online tech communities, expresses skepticism towards mainstream political narratives, advocates for the importance of personal responsibility and community support.
